description: This file defines a React context provider component 'AppSettingsProvider' that manages application-wide language and region settings, including persistence to localStorage, and a custom hook 'useAppSettings' for consuming these settings across the app.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads settings from localStorage, with fallback to default settings.

methods.name: AppSettingsProvider
methods.description: Provides context for app-wide language and region preferences with persistence.

methods.name: useAppSettings
methods.description: Custom hook to access language and region settings and their update functions.
